card.name: Ends of warning-section terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a multi-part term in drug-label warnings, such as 'Donation' in 'Blood Donation', 'ental' in 'placental', and 'ance' in 'Magnetic Resonance'.

modes.label: Blood Donation heading
modes.description: The word Donation right after Blood in a numbered warning heading.
modes.example: (5.11) Blood<< Donation>>: Avoid during therapy and for 6

modes.label: Placental
modes.description: The ending 'ental' of placental in statements about crossing the placenta.
modes.example: Thiazides cross the plac<<ental>> barrier and appear in cord blood.

modes.label: Other long terms
modes.description: The end of a long term such as Resonance in an MRI heading or a drug name.

card.plain: It fires on the closing part of a split-up term in warning sections, like Blood Donation or placental.
